tailoring.headline: Senior E-Commerce Technical Architect – SAP Commerce Cloud, API & Integration
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years delivering large-scale SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105/2211) solutions for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring, micro-services and headless OCC REST APIs, driving end-to-end PIM/ERP/MDM integrations. Proven record in agile, international teams, CI/CD, Docker/Kubernetes and AI-assisted analysis, translating business requirements into robust e-commerce platforms.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Senior SFCC B2C Technical Architect – Mirakl Marketplace
cover_en.hook: I am excited by Ann Huerta’s vision to build a cutting-edge Mirakl marketplace. With 5+ years leading SAP Commerce Cloud projects at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep expertise in scalable B2C e-commerce architectures and API-first integrations that align perfectly with this role.

bullets.label: API Integration
bullets.text: Designed and implemented robust PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines and OCC REST services, ensuring seamless product and order data flow across ERP and MDM systems.

bullets.label: Headless Architecture
bullets.text: Built headless commerce APIs for storefronts and third-party consumers, enabling flexible B2C experiences and rapid front-end innovation.

bullets.label: Technical Leadership
bullets.text: Led technical design, code reviews and production support for multi-regional teams, translating business requirements into performant Java/Spring solutions.

bullets.label: Agile Delivery
bullets.text: Delivered CI/CD-driven releases in Docker/Kubernetes environments, driving continuous improvement within Scrum and PI-Planning frameworks.

cover_en.logistics: Karlsruhe, valid work permit, serving notice until 15 December 2026, invitation to talk

tailoring.why_company: Ann Huerta’s focus on creating a best-in-class Mirakl marketplace aligns with my passion for building scalable, API-driven e-commerce platforms. I am eager to apply my SAP Commerce Cloud expertise and integration experience to accelerate your marketplace rollout, leveraging AI-assisted development to deliver high-quality, future-proof solutions.
tailoring.motivation_short: I want to bring my SAP Commerce Cloud and integration expertise to power Ann Huerta’s Mirakl marketplace, delivering robust B2C experiences at scale.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti Chavan, a senior SAP Commerce Cloud architect with 5+ years of API-centric e-commerce experience. I’m keen to discuss how I can help build Ann Huerta’s Mirakl marketplace. Let’s connect!
